capabilities: Mark changed notes with unread dots and folder unread counts
Show an unread inbox with attribution and plain-English summaries
Display a banner linking to each note's changelog and diff
Sync read state across devices without modifying note content
Configure read marking (dwell, instant, manual) and excluded folders
disambiguation: Not a messaging or sync plugin; it tracks which notes changed by others you have not yet reviewed and needs a separate sync service to move read state between devices.
extras: Some inbox features (sectioned views, urgency colours) are still in development and not shipped; a sync service is only needed for read state and badges to travel between devices.
problem: Obsidian gives no way to see which notes in a shared or synced vault have been changed by someone else and still need review.
summary: Read-state tracker that marks notes changed by other devices, collaborators, or automations with unread badges, an inbox, attribution, and diffs.
